notes: Transcribed from the supplied video. Category and setting order follow the menu.
Descriptions preserve the displayed wording, with line breaks and capitalization normalized.
Slider ranges are the demonstrated UI endpoints, inclusive. Exact step size and internal precision are not established by the video; step is null. Decimal controls display two decimal places.
Boolean false and true correspond to OFF and ON. Enum labels retain their displayed capitalization.
Null descriptions mean no description text was displayed when the setting was inspected. Null bounds mean the video did not demonstrate those limits.
Timestamps are approximate video positions. Currently selected values are not assumed to be defaults.
The Enemy Portal Wall Spawn Sort Weight slider remains at 5.00; its allowed range is not demonstrated.
The two in-progress respawn modifier descriptions permit negative values, but both demonstrated UI slider minima are 0.00.

settings.name: Round Length
settings.description: Number of seconds that a round should last. Set to -1 for infinite duration.

settings.name: Overtime Length
settings.description: Number of seconds that overtime should last. Set to -1 to disable overtime.

settings.name: Sudden Death Length
settings.description: The amount of time added to the timer for sudden death. A time of 0 or less will instantly end sudden death once no objectives are being interacted with.

settings.name: Allow Normal Sudden Death
settings.description: If true, sudden death can be triggered when the normal timer ends before going to overtime.

settings.name: Allow Overtime Sudden Death
settings.description: If true, sudden death can be triggered when the overtime timer ends.

settings.name: Spectate Closest Player on Start Spectating
settings.description: If we want to automatically spectate the nearest player upon starting spectating. If false we just freecam at our death's camera location.

settings.name: Spectate Player Who Killed Us when on Start Spectating as Participant
settings.description: If we want to try spectating the player that killed us when we start spectating. Only applies to situations that allow viewing enemies

settings.name: Can Spectate Enemies
settings.description: If spectators can ALWAYS spectate enemies, injunction or not.

settings.name: Can Spectate Enemies with Injunction Active
settings.description: Allows spectating enemies if you have injunctions blocking your respawn, even if bCanSpectateEnemies is false.

settings.name: Free Cam Enabled
settings.description: If true, spectators can control a "Free Cam" floating spectator pawn to observe the game

settings.name: Free Cam Enabled with Injunction Active
settings.description: If true, spectators can Free Cam even with injunctions blocking their respawn.

settings.name: One Shot One Kill
settings.description: If enabled, all weapons kill instantly

settings.name: Kill Score
settings.description: Applied when a player scores a kill

settings.name: Death Score
settings.description: Applied when a player dies (but not when they commit suicide)

settings.name: Assist Score
settings.description: Applied when a player scores an assist. Only applied to personal score, never to team score.

settings.name: Suicide Score
settings.description: Applied when a player kills themselves

settings.name: Friendly Fire Score
settings.description: Applied when a player kills a teammate

settings.name: Airdrops Enabled
settings.description: Whether airdrops are enabled

settings.name: Min Time Between Spawns
settings.description: The minimum time between triggering airdrop spawns.

settings.name: Max Time Between Spawns
settings.description: The maximum time between triggering airdrop spawns.

settings.name: Min Spawn Count
settings.description: The minimum number of airdrops to spawn at a time.

settings.name: Max Spawn Count
settings.description: The maximum number of airdrops to spawn at a time.

settings.name: Time Between Airdrops
settings.description: The time between each airdrop spawning when spawning multiple at a time.

settings.name: Min Objective Range
settings.description: The minimum distance from an objective that an airdrop is allowed to spawn. This is not exact due to how airdrop volumes work, but instead uses the center of the volume's bounds to disqualify a volume for airdrop spawning.

settings.name: Max Objective Range
settings.description: The maximum distance from an objective that an airdrop is allowed to spawn. This is not exact due to how airdrop volumes work, but instead uses the center of the volume's bounds to disqualify a volume for airdrop spawning.

settings.name: Min Average Player Range
settings.description: The minimum distance airdrops should spawn from the average of all player positions. This is not exact due to how airdrop volumes work, but instead uses the center of the volume's bounds to disqualify a volume for airdrop spawning.

settings.name: Max Average Player Range
settings.description: The maximum distance airdrops should spawn from the average of all player positions. This is not exact due to how airdrop volumes work, but instead uses the center of the volume's bounds to disqualify a volume for airdrop spawning.

settings.name: Team Wipes Enabled
settings.description: If true, rounds will be ended on a team wipe.

settings.name: Score Limit Enabled
settings.description: Whether the score limit is enabled.

settings.name: Score Limit
settings.description: The score at which the game will end.

settings.name: Always Show Scores
settings.description: If enabled, indicates that scores should show up even when score limits aren't enabled.

settings.name: Weapon Pickups Enabled
settings.description: If true, weapon pickups are enabled.

settings.name: Drop Only Equipped Weapon
settings.description: Drop only the currently equipped weapon on death.

settings.name: Life Span
settings.description: The amount of time before weapon pickups are destroyed (doesn't apply to pickups on item pads).

settings.name: Power Weapon Life Span
settings.description: The amount of time before power weapon pickups are destroyed (doesn't apply to pickups on item pads).

settings.name: Destroy Power Weapon Pickups Ammo Percentage
settings.description: If the power weapon pickup has less total ammo than this percentage of its magazine size, it will be destroyed.

settings.name: Destroy Weapon Pickups Ammo Percentage
settings.description: If the weapon pickup has less total ammo than this percentage of its magazine size, it will be destroyed.

settings.name: Destroy Pickups with No Ammo
settings.description: If true, weapon pickups with no ammo will be destroyed.

settings.name: Enable Map Boundaries
settings.description: Whether map boundaries are enabled.

settings.name: Item Pads Enabled
settings.description: If true, item pads will be made available at the start of the round.

settings.name: Item Respawning Enabled
settings.description: If true, item pads will respawn items after they are picked up within a round.

settings.name: Selection Behavior
settings.description: Defines how item pads select their items.

settings.name: Allow Friendly Fire
settings.description: If true, players on the same team can damage each other.

settings.name: Allow Enemy Healing
settings.description: If true, enemies can be healed by allied abilities.

settings.name: Ally Collision
settings.description: If true, allied players can collide with each other.

settings.name: Enemy Collision
settings.description: If true, enemy players can collide with each other.

settings.name: Show Enemy Respawn Timers
settings.description: If true, enemy respawn timers can/should be shown on the HUD.

settings.name: Show Enemy Health
settings.description: If true, enemy health can/should be shown on the HUD.

settings.name: Max Health
settings.description: The Max Health the player spawns with.

settings.name: Drop All Reserve Ammo
settings.description: If true, all reserve ammo for a weapon will be dropped when a weapon pickup is spawned.

settings.name: Infinite Magazine
settings.description: If true, weapons have infinite magazines.

settings.name: Infinite Reserves
settings.description: If true, weapons have infinite ammo reserves.

settings.name: Infinite Equipment
settings.description: If true, equipment has infinite uses.

settings.name: Damage Multiplier
settings.description: How much to multiply player outgoing damage by.

settings.name: Melee Damage Multiplier
settings.description: How much to multiply player melee damage by.

settings.name: Precision Damage Multiplier
settings.description: How much to multiply player precision damage by.

settings.name: Precision Damage Only
settings.description: Whether to enable precision damage only (e.g. headshots).

settings.name: Enable Big Head Mode
settings.description: Whether big head mode is enabled.

settings.name: Movement Speed Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for the player's movement speed (and acceleration)

settings.name: Gravity Scale Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for the player's gravity scale

settings.name: Jump Height Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for the player's jump velocity

settings.name: Allow Beginning Recharge in Air
settings.description: Whether the thruster can start to recharge while the player is in the air or on a non-walkable surface.

settings.name: Allow Recharge After Teleport
settings.description: Whether the thruster recharge can start when you go through a portal but are in mid-air, even when Allow Beginning Recharge in Air is false.

settings.name: Thruster Recharge Delay
settings.description: Time we need to wait for the thruster to start recharging.

settings.name: Lives Enabled
settings.description: If true, player respawns will be restricted based on their number of lives.

settings.name: Number Of Lives
settings.description: The number of lives granted to players by default.

settings.name: Disable Radar
settings.description: If true, the radar will be disabled on player HUDs.

settings.name: Weapon Attacks Reveal Self on Radar
settings.description: If enabled, the player is revealed on their enemy's radar when they attack with their weapon.

settings.name: Radar Boundary Extent
settings.description: The distance of how far the radar can see (in world units)

settings.name: Number of Portal Charges
settings.description: Number of portal uses before needing to recharge. Set to 0 for unlimited.

settings.name: Portal Gun Recharge Rate
settings.description: Recharge rate of our Portal Gun. Set to 0 to never recharge.

settings.name: Refill All Portals on Recharge
settings.description: Whether to fill all portal charges at once on recharge or one at a time.

settings.name: Portal Wall Overloading
settings.description: Whether or not to overload a Portal Wall when you place portals on it

settings.name: Enable Portals
settings.description: Whether portals are enabled

settings.name: Block Replacement Time
settings.description: The amount of time after placement that a portal can't be replaced by other players. Set to 0 to always allow replacement.

settings.name: Equipment Cooldown Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for the equipment cooldown

settings.name: Thruster Usage Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for how long a player can use the thruster

settings.name: Thruster Acceleration Multiplier
settings.description: Multiplier for the thruster's acceleration

settings.name: Enable Sprint
settings.description: Whether sprinting is enabled

settings.name: Enable Thruster
settings.description: Whether thruster is enabled

settings.name: Bots Enabled
settings.description: If true, bots will be spawned

settings.name: Auto Rebalance
settings.description: If true, bots will automatically try to rebalance teams if players join or leave during a round.

settings.name: Spawn Custom Num Bots
settings.description: If true, will spawn a custom number of bots. If false, will spawn bots until all player slots are filled.

settings.name: Custom Bot Num
settings.description: A custom number of bots to spawn

settings.name: Respawn Time
settings.description: The amount of time after dying that the player can respawn.

settings.name: Death Respawn Time Penalty
settings.description: Dead player gets this penalty applied to their respawn time (can be negative).

settings.name: Kill Respawn Time Penalty
settings.description: Killer gets this penalty applied to their respawn time (can be negative).

settings.name: Periodic Penalty Time
settings.description: If > 0, this is the repeating period after which all players' respawn penalties will increase.

settings.name: Periodic Penalty Amount
settings.description: If not 0, this is the amount by which all players' respawn penalties will increase after PeriodicPenaltyTime.

settings.name: Respawn Penalty Min
settings.description: Minimum value for respawn penalty.

settings.name: Respawn Penalty Max
settings.description: Maximum value for respawn penalty.

settings.name: Death in Progress Respawn Modifier
settings.description: Dead players (and their teammates, if team penalties are enabled) get this modifier applied to their current respawn time (can be negative).
settings.notes: The description says this can be negative, but the demonstrated slider minimum is 0.00.

settings.name: Kill in Progress Respawn Modifier
settings.description: Killers (and their teammates, if team penalties are enabled) get this modifier applied to their current respawn time (can be negative).
settings.notes: The description says this can be negative, but the demonstrated slider minimum is 0.00.

settings.name: Allow Timed Respawns
settings.description: If false, the timed respawn component will never trigger a respawn by itself.

settings.name: Team Based Respawn Penalties
settings.description: If true, team-based games will apply kill/death respawn penalties to the entire team rather than individual players. If false, kill/death respawn penalties will only apply to instigator/target.

settings.name: Always Use Team Spawns
settings.description: If true *and* in a team game, requires the use of team-specific spawns. This enables "CTF-style" spawning, where teams only ever spawn in their own bases.

settings.name: Require Nearby Allies
settings.description: If true, only spawns with allies nearby will be considered. This is a simple "is an ally nearby" check, it is not weighted like enemies are. If there are no allies found then this option is ignored. This option isn't super useful for normal arena maps.

settings.name: Require Nearby Objective
settings.description: If true, only spawns with objectives nearby will be considered. This is a simple "is an objective nearby" check, it is not weighted like enemies are. If there are no objectives found then this option is ignored.

settings.name: Require No Nearby Objective
settings.description: If true, only spawns with objectives beyond a specific distance will be considered.

settings.name: Ally Consideration Distance
settings.description: The max distance from an ally for a spawn to be considered when bRequireNearbyAllies is on.

settings.name: Objective Max Distance
settings.description: The maximum distance away from objectives that a player should spawn at. Only used if bRequireNearbyObjective is enabled.

settings.name: Objective Min Distance
settings.description: The minimum distance away from objectives that a player should spawn at. Only used if bRequireNoNearbyObjective is enabled.

settings.name: Enemy Portal Spawn Sort Weight
settings.description: How much linked enemy portals influence spawn location selection (higher is less influence).

settings.name: Enemy Unlinked Portal Spawn Sort Weight
settings.description: How much unlinked enemy portals influence spawn location selection (higher is less influence).

settings.name: Enemy Portal Wall Spawn Sort Weight
settings.description: How much enemy-viewed Portal Walls influence spawn location selection (higher is less influence).
settings.notes: The clip shows 5.00 but does not demonstrate the slider endpoints. Minimum and maximum are unknown.

settings.name: Enemy Far Distance
settings.description: Distance at which an enemy actor is considered far away. The spawn will be assumed to not be visible if an enemy is far away and the spawn is behind them.

settings.name: Enemy Portal Wall Consideration Distance
settings.description: The distance at which Portal Walls will be searched for when finding ones within line of sight of enemies.

settings.name: Enemy Portal Consideration Distance
settings.description: The distance at which portals will be searched for when finding ones within line of sight of enemies.

settings.name: Prevent Spawning when Team Is Dead
settings.description: If true, blocks respawning once your team is dead.
